en: Today we're going to learn multiplication — here it's both equal groups and the times table.
de: Heute lernen wir Multiplikation — here it's both gleiche Gruppen and the Einmaleins.

en: In practice you'll find triangle areas — make sure the height is perpendicular to the base!
de: In der Übung findest du triangle areas — make sure the height is perpendicular to the base!

en: Today in geometry we will learn an important rule: the sum of angles in a triangle = 180°.
de: Heute lernen wir in Geometrie eine wichtige Regel: the sum of angles in a triangle = 180°.

en: Today in geometry we will learn the perimeter of a triangle — the sum of all three sides.
de: Heute lernen wir in Geometrie den Umfang eines Dreiecks — the sum of all three sides.

en: In practice you'll find trapezoid areas — add bases, multiply by height, and divide by 2!
de: In der Übung findest du trapezoid areas — add bases, multiply by height, and divide by 2!

en: Important: here we don't practice remainders or long division — only simple fair sharing.
de: Wichtig: here we don't practice remainders or schriftliche Division — only simple gerechtes Teilen.

en: Today we'll learn to estimate a multiplication answer — round the factors, then multiply.
de: Heute lernen wir, ein Multiplikationsergebnis zu schätzen — round the factors, then multiply.

en: In practice you'll find parallelogram areas — make sure the distance is perpendicular!
de: In der Übung findest du parallelogram areas — make sure the distance is perpendicular!

en: In practice you'll find dimensions — calculate one layer, then multiply by the height!
de: In der Übung findest du dimensions — calculate one layer, then multiply by the height!

en: Now you know how to solve equal-group problems — like the times table, but in a story.
de: Jetzt weißt du, wie du solve equal-group problems — like the Einmaleins, but in a story.

en: Second way — rows: each row has a certain number of squares; how many rows? Multiply.
de: Second way — rows: each row has a certain number of squares; how many rows? Multiply.

en: In practice you'll find questions: how much is missing to make 10? Use the ten-frame!
de: In der Übung findest du questions: how much is missing to make 10? Use the Zehnerfeld!

en: 2,999 → 3,000: the neighbor after 2,999 = 3,000 — crossing a thousand, still just +1.
de: 2,999 → 3,000: the neighbor after 2,999 = 3,000 — crossing a thousand, still just +1.

en: In practice you'll find prisms — calculate base area first, then multiply by height!
de: In der Übung findest du prisms — calculate base area first, then multiply by height!

en: Every flower smells a little different — that is the sense of smell helping us know.
de: Every flower smells a little different — that is the sense of smell helping us know.

en: Today we will learn about ratios — a comparison between two parts of the same kind.
de: Heute lernen wir etwas über ratios — a comparison between two parts of the same kind.

en: In practice you will find sequences with missing terms — write down the step first!
de: In der Übung findest du sequences with missing terms — write down the step first!

de: - Transparency — light passes through (glass); opacity — light does not pass (wall)
